module.name: scmlpick
module.author: Texas Seismological Network (TexNet)
module.description: Real-time seismic phase picking using machine-learning models (EQCCT by default)

parameter.name: whiteChanns
parameter.description: Define the list of channles types that are allowed to process. Example: HH, CH

parameter.name: Pmodel
parameter.description: EQCCT model to detect P phases.

parameter.name: Smodel
parameter.description: EQCCT model to detect S phases.

parameter.name: windowLength
parameter.description: Define the data window length in seconds to send to eqcct.

parameter.name: filterShift
parameter.description: Define the time shift to initialize the filter. This data will not be processed, so timeShift must be greater than this. (in seconds)

parameter.name: probThreshold
parameter.description: Minimum probability to reach to send a new pick.

parameter.name: timeShift
parameter.description: Define the time in seconds to overlap with the previous window.

parameter.name: minStasBulk
parameter.description: Minimum number of stations with windowLength data available to send to EQCCT after firstWait. This number should be less than the total stations. At least this number of real-time stations must be available to produce picks.

parameter.name: minDelayStasBulk
parameter.description: Minimum number of delayed stations with windowLength data available to send to EQCCT after firstWait. This number should be less than the total stations.

parameter.name: firstWait
parameter.description: Minimum delay between now and the end time of the last minute saved in memory to compute all data available. First computation.

parameter.name: secondWait
parameter.description: Minimum time to wait after first computation to proceed with Second computation.

parameter.name: maxWait
parameter.description: Maximum time to wait after first computation to proceed with second computation.

parameter.name: startLatency
parameter.description: Define time in seconds to wait before sending the first data packet to eqcct.

parameter.name: timeRemoveTrace
parameter.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait before remove traces from the processing stream.

parameter.name: traceDelay
parameter.description: Minimum delay in seconds between the current time and the start time of data acquired to send data to delayed data processing.

parameter.name: eqcctPthr
parameter.description: Minimum probability to reach to send a new P pick.

parameter.name: eqcctSthr
parameter.description: Minimum probability to reach to send a new S pick.

parameter.name: eqcctOverlap
parameter.description: If set the detection and picking are performed in overlapping windows.

parameter.name: eqcctBatchSize
parameter.description: Batch size. This wont affect the speed much but can affect the performance. A value beteen 200 to 1000 is recommended.

parameter.name: defaultPickerModel
parameter.description: Fallback picker when a station binding has no profiles.*.pickerModel. EQCCT = TensorFlow/EQCCT; otherwise Parent/Child for SeisBench (scconfig shows a drop-down when values is set).

parameter.name: detectionThreshold
parameter.description: SeisBench model.classify Detection_threshold (0–1). EQCCT picking uses eqcctPthr / eqcctSthr instead.

parameter.name: waveformFilterType
parameter.description: ObsPy Stream.filter type before 100 Hz resampling: bandpass, bandstop, lowpass, or highpass (same as eqcctpro.waveform_filter). profiles.*.filter BW(hp,lp) still supplies corners when matched.

parameter.name: waveformFilterCorners
parameter.description: Filter order corners passed to ObsPy (eqcctpro default 2).

parameter.name: waveformFilterZerophase
parameter.description: If true, use forward-backward (zero-phase) filtering (ObsPy zerophase=True).

parameter.name: gpuID
parameter.description: Primary CUDA device index when ray.gpuDeviceIds is unset: use -1 for CPU-only. If ray.gpuDeviceIds is set, it defines all GPU IDs and Ray num_gpus = len(list).

parameter.name: gpuLimit
parameter.description: Legacy GPU tuning parameter (site-specific). For ModelActor/Ripper VRAM caps prefer ray.actorGpuMemoryLimitMB / ray.ripperGpuMemoryLimitMB.

parameter.name: profiles
parameter.description: Profile names must match the profiles in the bindings configuration.

parameter.name: Standard
parameter.description: If enabled, the module sends picks to the messaging system as soon as the module produces them. In the default setup, 1-minute windows are processed every 30 seconds.

parameter.name: Simulation
parameter.description: If enabled, the module sends picks simulating the true arrival time but includes a delay corresponding to the first processed window.

parameter.name: Bulk
parameter.description: If enabled, the module stores picks and sends them to the messaging system periodically, at a configurable time interval.

parameter.name: bulkInverval
parameter.description: Inverval in seconds used when bulk pick delivery strategy is enabled

parameter.name: pickTargetGroup
parameter.description: This is the name of the group to send pick messages for specific profile when standard pick delivery strategy is enabled

parameter.name: pickSimulTargetGroup
parameter.description: This is the name of the group to which pick messages will be sent for a specific profile when simulation pick delivery strategy is enabled

parameter.name: pickBulkTargetGroup
parameter.description: This is the name of the group to which pick messages will be sent for a specific profile when bulk pick delivery strategy is enabled.

parameter.name: locTargetGroup
parameter.description: This is the name of the group to send location messages for specific profile

parameter.name: authorTarget
parameter.description: This author should match the origin (location) author for locations to be checked against quality control parameters.

parameter.name: region
parameter.description: The BNA file defining regions (closed polygons) or tuple with 4 elements. Inside this region, the origin evaluation status is TrueOrgEvalStat, and outside is FalseOrgEvalStat. If this is set to none, then the origin location will not be checked against any polygon.

parameter.name: inferenceMode
parameter.description: modelActor: persistent eqcctpro ModelActor pool (weights loaded once). ripper: each picker task loads EQCCT (higher overhead; use with ray.maxTasksQueue for concurrency). Also: --inference-mode on CLI.

parameter.name: numModelActors
parameter.description: Number of ModelActors when inferenceMode=modelActor (0 = auto from ray.maxTasksQueue and number of visible GPUs). Also: --num-model-actors on CLI.

parameter.name: gpuDeviceIds
parameter.description: Comma-separated CUDA device IDs, e.g. 0 or 0,1. Sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and Ray num_gpus. If empty, uses eqcct.gpuID alone when it is >= 0. Also: --gpu-devices on CLI.

parameter.name: actorGpuMemoryLimitMB
parameter.description: Optional TensorFlow soft VRAM limit per ModelActor (MB). 0 = no limit (dynamic growth). Ignored in ripper mode.

parameter.name: ripperGpuMemoryLimitMB
parameter.description: Optional TensorFlow soft VRAM limit per picker task when inferenceMode=ripper and GPUs are visible (MB). 0 = no limit.

parameter.name: numCPUs
parameter.description: Number of CPUs allocated for running the run_picker() to create the time chunks.

parameter.name: maxTasksQueue
parameter.description: Maximum number of Ray picker tasks in flight (concurrent stations/time windows). Caps ModelActor round-robin load and Ripper concurrency.

parameter.name: numWorkers
parameter.description: Number of groups to split stations. Each group will work in parallel without affecting the others. This helps prevent delays when working with a large number of stations and is usually only required when running more than 100 stations in real time.

parameter.name: latUncTHR
parameter.description: Set the latitude uncertainty threshold. Above this value, the origin evaluation status is FalseOrgEvalStat, and below is TrueOrgEvalStat.

parameter.name: lonUncTHR
parameter.description: Set the longitude uncertainty threshold. Above this value, the origin evaluation status is FalseOrgEvalStat, and below is TrueOrgEvalStat.

parameter.name: depthUncTHR
parameter.description: Set the depth uncertainty threshold. Above this value, the origin evaluation status is FalseOrgEvalStat, and below is TrueOrgEvalStat.

parameter.name: depthTHR
parameter.description: Set the depth threshold. Above this value, the origin evaluation status is FalseOrgEvalStat, and below is TrueOrgEvalStat.

parameter.name: azGapTHR
parameter.description: Set the azimuthal gap threshold. Above this value, the origin evaluation status is FalseOrgEvalStat, and below is TrueOrgEvalStat.

parameter.name: TrueOrgEvalStat
parameter.description: Set the origin evaluation status to use when the origin fulfills all quality thresholds. Use integers from 0 to 5. Each integer means following next list: 0=preliminary, 1=confirmed, 2=reviewed, 3=final, 4=rejected, 5=reported.

parameter.name: FalseOrgEvalStat
parameter.description: Set the origin evaluation status to use when the origin does not fulfill one or more quality thresholds. Use integers from 0 to 5. Each integer means following next list: 0=preliminary, 1=confirmed, 2=reviewed, 3=final, 4=rejected, 5=reported

binding.description: Configures a station for picking. A station without a binding assigned will not be picked.

parameter.name: profiles
parameter.description: Profile names must match the profiles in the module configuration.

group.name: profiles
group.description: Activate the station for a specific profile. Profiles must exist in both the module configuration and the bindings.

parameter.name: pickEnable
parameter.description: Enables/disables picking on a station.

parameter.name: filter
parameter.description: Defines the filter to be used for picking.

parameter.name: pickerModel
parameter.description: Picker backend: EQCCT or a SeisBench Parent/Child preset (same list as eqcct.defaultPickerModel). scconfig uses values for a drop-down; unknown strings are rejected at runtime.
